dogecoin.text: @TheCryptoLark What makes you think there is a relationship between utility and value? What is the utility of Cowrie Shells? Gold Sovereigns? Bitcoin? Dogecoin?

Cryptocurrencies are commodities. They acquire value from supply vs demand in the market. If the market values $doge or #safemoon and you don't that it is not because the market is wrong. Your personal taste is irrelevant.
